domains.name: Property Identity
domains.family: UPRN/address, georeferenced land references and authority geography
domains.gate: Identity must be confirmed before any site-specific rule outcome.

domains.name: Title & Legal Restrictions
domains.family: HM Land Registry official records, filed deeds and client conveyancing materials
domains.gate: Planning permission does not extinguish private restrictions or rights.

domains.name: Physical Property & Land
domains.family: Measured surveys, site photography, mapping geometry and GSIE model
domains.gate: Record survey tolerances and unresolved building geometry.

domains.name: Planning History
domains.family: LPA planning portal, decision notices, stamped plans and enforcement records
domains.gate: Historic decisions and conditions must be applied to the correct parcel.

domains.name: GPDO & Permitted Development
domains.family: GPDO text as amended, Article 4 instruments, approved plans and measured design
domains.gate: Test all class-specific conditions, limitations, exclusions and dates.

domains.name: Local Planning Policy
domains.family: Adopted local plan, LPA map and supplementary design documents
domains.gate: Clearly distinguish adopted policies, guidance and emerging proposals.

domains.name: Heritage
domains.family: Historic England, LPA conservation/heritage records and specialist appraisal
domains.gate: Proximity does not establish an adverse heritage impact by itself.

domains.name: Flooding & Drainage
domains.family: Environment Agency, LLFA, water undertaker and site drainage evidence
domains.gate: Screening map classifications do not replace an FRA or site study.

domains.name: Mining & Geology
domains.family: Mining Remediation Authority, BGS, historic maps and geotechnical reports
domains.gate: Site investigation is needed where mapped hazards could affect works.

domains.name: Electricity & Utilities
domains.family: DNO/statutory undertaker records, utility survey, deeds and easements
domains.gate: Underground asset locations need field validation before excavation.

domains.name: Street Furniture & Highways
domains.family: Highway authority, traffic orders, street asset inventories and site survey
domains.gate: Public realm assets and access rights require direct authority checks.

domains.name: Trees & Ecology
domains.family: LPA tree records, DEFRA data, surveys and professional ecology inputs
domains.gate: Protected habitats and trees may require timed/specialist surveys.

domains.name: Environmental Hazards
domains.family: EA, LPA environment registers, historic land use and site studies
domains.gate: Screening alone cannot certify the absence of hazardous conditions.

domains.name: Building Intelligence
domains.family: ISIE E01/P02, measured drawings, structural / fire / MEP evidence
domains.gate: Model-derived changes require structural, life-safety and survey gates.

domains.name: Licensing & Lawful Use
domains.family: LPA licensing designations, use history and local occupation standards
domains.gate: Licensing, lawful use and planning rights are different regimes.

domains.name: Development Context
domains.family: Nearby LPA cases, highway programmes, surveys and scenario models
domains.gate: Compare alternative proposals with transparent assumptions.

domains.name: Evidence & Readiness
domains.family: Evidence service, ingestion logs, versioned models and sign-off register
domains.gate: A result without provenance or a release gate cannot be represented as verified.

checks.name: UPRN matching
checks.evidence: AddressBase/official UPRN match and selected property address
checks.acceptance: Confirm UPRN identifies the intended building/parcel and is unique
switchesNeeded: set DATABASE_URL or set OS_DATA_HUB_KEY
checks.note: UPRN from OS Places, or nearest OS Open UPRN point (high/low confidence + candidate list).

checks.name: Address normalisation
checks.evidence: Raw source address, postal record and standardised address output
checks.acceptance: Compare house number, street, unit, postcode and alias matches
checks.note: Address model with postcode validation. No alias / postal-record comparison.

checks.name: OS grid reference
checks.evidence: National Grid eastings/northings or authoritative georeferenced geometry
checks.acceptance: Confirm coordinate system, spatial accuracy and property match
switchesNeeded: set OS_DATA_HUB_KEY
checks.note: Easting/northing only when OS Places is used (null for OSM addresses). WGS84 to BNG converter exists but is not stored on the record.

checks.name: Parcel centroid
checks.evidence: Polygon centroid coordinates from authoritative property/site geometry
checks.acceptance: Confirm centroid sits within the selected parcel, not neighbouring land
checks.note: Centroids are computed inside the geometry code but never stored or reported as a result.

checks.name: Title number matching
checks.evidence: Official register title number plus UPRN-to-title cross-reference
checks.acceptance: Check title corresponds to the intended legal parcel; flag split titles
